info.name: Regulations.gov comment submission utilities documents API

params.name: filter[agencyId]
params.description: 'Filters results for the agency acronym specified in the value. Example: ''EPA'''

params.name: filter[commentEndDate]
params.description:
Filters results relative to the comment end date. The value must be formatted as `yyyy-MM-dd`.

Omission of a parameter modifier will match results to the exact date provided, otherwise, one of the parameter modifiers below may be used.
`ge` - greater than or equal
`le` - less than or equal

params.name: filter[docketId]
params.description: Filters results on the specified docket ID.

params.name: filter[documentType]
params.description: Filters results on the specified document type.

params.name: filter[frDocNum]
params.description: Filters results on the specified frDocNum.

params.name: filter[searchTerm]
params.description: Filters results on the given term.

params.name: filter[postedDate]
params.description:
Filters results relative to the posted date. The value must be formatted as `yyyy-MM-dd`.

Omission of a parameter modifier will match results to the exact date provided, otherwise, one of the parameter modifiers below may be used.
`ge` - greater than or equal
`le` - less than or equal

params.name: filter[lastModifiedDate]
params.description:
Filters results relative to the last modified date. The value must be formatted as `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`.

Omission of a parameter modifier will match results to the exact date provided, otherwise, one of the parameter modifiers below may be used.
`ge` - greater than or equal
`le` - less than or equal

params.name: filter[subtype]
params.description: Filters results on the supplied document subtype

params.name: filter[withinCommentPeriod]
params.description:
Filters results for documents that are open for comment by setting the value to `true`.

_`False` is not an acceptable value for this parameter, hence it should be removed when not being used._

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sorts the results on the field specified in the value. The default behavior will sort the results in ascending order; to sort in descending order, prepend a minus sign to the value.

Supported values are `commentEndDate`, `postedDate`, `lastModifiedDate`, `documentId` and `title`. Multiple sort options can be passed in as a comma separated list to sort results by multiple fields.

params.name: page[number]
params.description:
Specifies the number for the page of results that will be returned from the query.

Acceptable values are numerical between, and including, 1 and 20.

params.name: page[size]
params.description:
Specifies the size per page of results that will be returned from the query.

Acceptable values are numerical between, and including, 5 and 250.

items.docs: This endpoint returns list of documents

info.name: Get detailed information for specified documentId

items.docs: Gets the detailed information of a specific document with the passed documentId.
